outputs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. FOUR full-body original Frostbeacon Pike battle paintings in a TWO by TWO sheet. Image 1 is authoritative identity and FULL pike proportions. Image 2 shows the forward lunge action but its shaft is incomplete: restore the long rear shaft and small butt spike, ignore neighboring stray blade fragments at top corners. Same original human face, blue fur-lined hood and quilted long coat, silver breastplate/shoulders/front strip, small amber chest badge, brown gloves/boots. Fixed elevated 3/4 camera facing RIGHT. Exactly one long rigid brown wooden pike with broad steel spearhead and SMALL steel butt spike, held with TWO well-separated hands. Full pike length approximately 1.3 times standing head-to-sole height; identical in all four poses, both tips fully inside generous cell margins.
Top-left: horizontal chest-height thrust WINDUP: pike tip points RIGHT, both elbows bent drawing grip rearward toward ribs, near hand rearward at right hip, far hand forward on shaft, weight back, no overhead pose.
Top-right: forward two-hand THRUST: front knee bends, rear leg extends, arms push toward right; retain LONG visible shaft behind rear hand continuing left to butt spike, spear point extends right. Full intact weapon, not short spear or shaft ending in palm.
Bottom-left: RECOVERY: elbows bend pulling same horizontal pike back toward waist, front knee straightens slightly, torso returns upright, both hands never release.
Bottom-right: ready guard: both feet planted and knees soft, pike angled head upper RIGHT and butt lower LEFT, both hands separated across torso. This is a softer ready pose before a crouching brace.
Original painterly tactical game art; same anatomical and equipment scale throughout. Flat vivid green #00ff00 with no reflected green; no floor shadow, arrows, effects, labels, borders, extra weapons or background scenery.
outputs.selection_notes: 13 packed frames retain nine original RGBA paintings and select four new full-pike paintings. Horizontal two-hand anticipation, thrust with intact rear shaft/butt spike, withdrawal and ready guard replace the disconnected overhead windup and truncated-shaft thrust. Original brace, recoil, kneel, side fall and head-right corpse remain. Original alpha reused; new green-backed sheet prepared with owner-approved bounded matte/edge cleanup. Uniform per-source scales 0.62/0.36 and anatomical anchors; banded cuts retain full new guard tip without neighboring thrust boots and exclude original neighboring spear tip from brace. Only original contact/passing are retained for travel; a full alternating gait remains missing. Pike orientation between idle/travel/guard, projection/length through fall, body/hand proportions, edges/palette and connected event timing remain refinement. Packed and inspected, not final motion acceptance.
